description: Use this when the user asks what data centers are being built, announced or permitted in a market or by an operator. Example: "What is under construction in Northern Virginia and when does it come online?" — get_pipeline market=northern-virginia status=construction. Params: market (slug or name, e.g. "northern-virginia", "dallas"; projects labelled only with the state are counted apart, see scope.note); state (USPS, e.g. "VA"); status one of "announced" | "permitted" | "construction" | "operational"; operator (e.g. "Equinix", "AWS"); country (ISO-2, e.g. "US"); min_capacity_mw (e.g. 50); expected_completion_before (ISO date; undated projects are kept and marked, completion_filter counts them); limit/offset. Each row carries expected_cod, null with expected_cod_basis when no source states one. One named project: name="Stargate Abilene" (or a codename, developer plus place) returns the best matching record first, with developer, county, state, stated MW, status, expected_cod, source_url and as_of, other matching records beside it, or name_lookup.message saying no record matches. Do NOT use for already-operational facilities (use search_facilities) or for the M&A deal flow (use list_transactions). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, DE, SG

expected_completion_before.description: Only projects with expected commissioning before this ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. 2027-01-01

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

market.description: Market slug or name to keep projects inside, e.g. northern-virginia, dallas

min_capacity_mw.description: Minimum project power capacity filter in megawatts (MW), e.g. 50 for hyperscale

name.description: A named project or campus, e.g. "Stargate Abilene", "Project Firecracker" or "Crusoe Abilene": the best matching record comes first; when nothing matches, name_lookup.message says so

operator.description: Operator/provider company name, e.g. Equinix, Digital Realty, AWS

state.description: US state (USPS code), e.g. VA, TX

status.description: Pipeline stage filter: announced, permitted, construction, or operational

name: get_pipeline
title: Construction Pipeline
